title.value: Assessing the impact of aircraft arrival on ambient ultrafine particle number concentrations in near-airport communities in Boston, Massachusetts
title.justification: The title clearly indicates that the paper is focused on evaluating the impact of aircraft arrivals on ultrafine particle concentrations in communities near an airport.
title.quote: Assessing the impact of aircraft arrival on ambient ultrafine particle number concentrations in near-airport communities in Boston, Massachusetts

extractions.description: This study investigates the contribution of aircraft arrivals to ultrafine particle (UFP) concentrations in communities near Boston Logan International Airport. The research utilizes real-time aircraft activity and meteorological data across six sites varying in distance from the flight path to evaluate PNC levels, which serve as a proxy for UFP. Findings highlight elevated PNC levels associated with flight activity, especially at sites closer to the airport, indicating significant but intermittent aviation contributions to ambient PNC.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on the impact of aircraft arrival on ultrafine particle concentrations rather than addressing Climate Change as the central theme. It does not directly link its findings to Climate Change issues such as global warming, greenhouse gas emissions, or other related climate topics.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Our findings suggest strong but intermittent contributions from arrival aircraft to ambient PNC in communities near airports.

primary_category.justification: The paper deals with the issue of ultrafine particle pollution resulting from aircraft emissions, which falls under the broader category of Pollution in the context of Climate Change.
primary_category.quote: Aircraft emissions contribute to overall ambient air pollution, including ultrafine particle (UFP) concentrations.

primary_sub_category.justification: The focus on ultrafine particles as a form of air pollution is explicitly addressed in the paper, and this sub-category is the most fitting given the content of the study.
primary_sub_category.quote: Aircraft emissions contribute to overall ambient air pollution, including ultrafine particle (UFP) concentrations.

applications.value: Understanding and attributing air pollution sources in communities near airports
applications.justification: The paper's application of its research helps in identifying and understanding the sources of air pollution, particularly ultrafine particles in residential areas near airports.
applications.quote: Regression models indicated that the number of arrival aircraft per hour was associated with measured PNC at all six sites, with a maximum contribution of 50% of total PNC at a monitor 3 km from the airport during hours with arrival activity.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories and sub-categories sufficiently characterize the content of the paper without requiring new definitions.
new_primary_category.quote: Aircraft emissions contribute to overall ambient air pollution, including ultrafine particle (UFP) concentrations.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The focus on air pollution, specifically ultrafine particles, fits well within the existing sub-category of Air Pollution.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Aircraft emissions contribute to overall ambient air pollution, including ultrafine particle (UFP) concentrations.
